The montage is in solid shape:
- **Duration**: 30s exactly, matching the brief.
- **Shot variety**: clip lengths range from 1.5s to 4s across the 11 cuts (camera, b-roll, and vertical-source footage interleaved), giving the rhythmic variation a fast-paced montage needs rather than a mechanical grid.
- **Framing**: every landscape source (camera + all four b-roll assets) has been cropped to fill the vertical frame; the two native-vertical clips need no crop and already match.
- **Music**: the 100bpm beat bed runs the full 30s under the cuts.

One thing to flag rather than silently fix: the two vertical-source shots (4.5s and 18.5s frames) carry a strong cyan/teal color cast and, at 18.5s, motion blur that makes the shot read as an indistinct blurred pan rather than a clear "strongest moment." No color grading was part of this request, so I haven't touched it, but if you want a corrected white balance on those two shots or a swap to a sharper moment from that same clip, say the word and I'll do a targeted color match or reselect the source range — I didn't want to grade footage you didn't ask me to grade.
